descriptions.artifact_frozen: the artifact was written atomically and verifies against its digest
descriptions.challenge_injected_once: the challenge fired exactly once and the original action was recorded, not executed
descriptions.evaluator_decided: the evaluator returned an explicit boolean resolved
descriptions.image_started: the task image ran and the agent executed inside it
descriptions.termination_registered: the run ended with a registered code, with the step limit and the 1200 s cap distinguishable
descriptions.valid_tool_call: the agent produced at least one valid tool call

note: resolved is reported, never gated on: whether the task was solved says nothing about whether the chain is connected
